requirements.desc: R1: container registers null for config when load fails, config object otherwise
requirements.note: `src/lib/container.js` changes default from `{}` to `null`, and new `container-init` unit tests verify null-vs-object behavior.

requirements.desc: R2: config-required commands fail with NO_CONFIG before business logic when config missing
requirements.note: `src/lib/dispatcher.js` adds early `requiresConfig && container.get("config") == null` guard emitting `NO_CONFIG` with canonical message and non-zero exit; tests verify command body is not executed.

requirements.desc: R3: requiresConfig flag declared in registry for config-using commands only
requirements.note: Registry now supports `requiresConfig` and applies it to `flow prepare` in `src/flow/registry.js`; default remains optional for other commands.

requirements.desc: R4: NO_CONFIG generation consolidated into a single common pre-check layer
requirements.note: Local `NO_CONFIG` check in `src/flow.js` was removed and centralized in dispatcher precheck.

requirements.desc: R5: command bodies have no defensive config fallbacks (|| {} patterns removed)
requirements.note: The shown fallback in `src/flow/commands/merge.js` was removed, but the diff alone does not prove repository-wide removal of all such patterns.

requirements.desc: R6: setup/help/upgrade/presets behave identically to pre-change when config missing
requirements.note: Implementation design supports this (only flagged commands are blocked), and dispatcher test covers a help-like unflagged command, but exact parity for all four concrete commands is not directly demonstrated in this diff.
No command names, args, or option schemas were changed; only internal metadata/precheck behavior was added.
